processes.name: Dealer Order Intake & Quoting
processes.description: Manages dealer requests, generates quotes using Excel pricing templates, and routes for approval before order confirmation.
pain_points: Dealer-set retail prices creating margin ambiguity

processes.name: Production Scheduling & Shop Floor Coordination
processes.description: Maintains weekly production schedules, tracks order registers and inventory sheets, and manages paper work orders through the shop floor.
pain_points: Paper work orders slowing floor updates

processes.name: Purchasing, Receiving & Inventory Management
processes.description: Handles supplier ordering via Excel/Outlook, processes paper receiving records, and maintains working stock counts separate from accounting software.
pain_points: Excel stock sheets not synced with QuickBooks
Paper receiving records prone to loss

processes.name: Trailer Manufacturing, Assembly & Quality Inspection
processes.description: Coordinates steel frame fabrication, panel fitting, wiring, running gear installation, and pre-shipment inspection against dealer-specified models and options.
pain_points: Manual model/option verification against load labels

processes.name: Shipping, Invoicing & Dealer Delivery Coordination
processes.description: Coordinates factory shipment, generates invoices, and manages dealer-arranged delivery appointments while handling post-shipment status inquiries.
pain_points: Dealer-arranged delivery scheduling causing coordination overhead
Invoice timing misaligned with dealer payment terms

processes.name: Warranty Claims & Dealer Support
processes.description: Routes dealer-reported issues to quality leads, evaluates case-specific coverage terms, and approves pre-repair actions before processing claims.
pain_points: No blanket coverage policy requiring case-by-case review
